analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($314.70) vs SMA5/20/50($312.21/$289.64/$292.77) — Above short-term SMA5, below mid-term SMA20/50
· Position vs SMA100/200($350.36/$465.30) — Weakness below mid-to-long term trends
· 52-week Position(11.2%) + Current price range near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (47.3 → 58.7) — Exited oversold, now consolidating in neutral zone
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (3.2799 → 5.6684) — Remains positive but improvement is weakening
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid-band $289.64) — Consolidating near the mid-band
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($300.50) — Based on Pivot (PP $303.67) and 5-day low ($286.30)
· Swing Resistance ($363.18) — Below R2 ($381.24)
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (No Higher Low formed/Consolidation) — Lack of trend reversal signals
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.70x) — Volume contracted compared to the 5-day average
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Zone) — Neutral RSI, weak MACD improvement, and contracted volume indicate weak buying/selling pressure, maintaining an 'Observe' stance.
analysis.patternNote: 일봉상 RSI와 MACD 지표가 방향성을 명확히 제시하지 못하고 있어, 5일 연속 음봉 후 반등 시도했으나 거래량 동반 없이 약한 모습을 보이며 횡보 구간 지속.
analysis.patternNoteEn: On the daily chart, RSI and MACD indicators lack clear directional signals. After 5 consecutive days of decline, a rebound attempt was made but showed weakness without accompanying volume, continuing the consolidation phase.
